prompt: Write the body (about 180 words) of a demand letter from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer before a lawsuit. Accident: hit while turning left. Injury: concussion. Use the exact placeholders [CLIENT_NAME], [LOSS_DATE] and [DEMAND_AMOUNT]. No other names or dates. (Internal reference C-1270; do not mention it.)
text:
Our office represents [CLIENT_NAME] in connection with injuries sustained in a motor vehicle collision that occurred on [LOSS_DATE]. Our client was lawfully traveling through an intersection when your insured, while turning left, failed to yield the right of way and struck our client's vehicle. The police report and the physical damage to both vehicles support the conclusion that your insured bears full responsibility for this collision.

As a direct result of the impact, [CLIENT_NAME] suffered a concussion. Our client experienced persistent headaches, dizziness, light sensitivity, and difficulty concentrating, and was advised by treating physicians to limit screen time and avoid strenuous activity for an extended period. Our client has incurred substantial medical expenses for emergency care, diagnostic imaging, neurological evaluation, and ongoing follow-up treatment, and has missed significant time from work during recovery.

Liability in this matter is clear, and the damages are well documented. We invite your company to resolve this claim promptly and fairly. Our client will consider a settlement in the amount of [DEMAND_AMOUNT], inclusive of all medical expenses, lost wages, and general damages. This offer will remain open for thirty days from the date of this letter. If we do not receive a satisfactory response within that period, we are prepared to file suit without further notice.
